description:
Subscribe an email address to a Vibe Shipped newsletter: "daily" (the Daily Ship: new apps built with AI) or "agent-brief" (weekly Agent Brief on AI coding tools and harnesses).

Use when: only when the user explicitly asks to subscribe and gives their own email address. Never subscribe an address the user did not provide.

Behavior: Write: stores the subscription and returns a receipt that can be used to unsubscribe (DELETE /api/subscribe). Idempotent for the same email and list.

Example: {"email":"me@example.com","list":"agent-brief"}
name: subscribe_newsletter
title: Subscribe to a Vibe Shipped newsletter
